set.body:
Objective

Represent neural measurements by identified factors L rather than only by metrics M = L^T L whenever open measurement coordinates or oriented cross-region structure matter.

Scope and deliverables

- Add validated private measurement_leg values with source space, output space, basis identity, units, support, fixed or learned provenance, and exact semantic signature.
- Add measurement_frame values with ordered legs, frame operator metadata, coverage, decomposition identity, and optional injectivity guarantee.
- Add measurement_edges values containing only explicitly requested ordered node pairs and optional semantic weights.
- Add direct-sum measurement decompositions that preserve component identities.
- Canonically adapt existing additive frames through coordinate-preserving square-root legs and coherent common-mode legs.
- Define canonical dual-frame metadata without claiming numerical stability from shape alone.

Acceptance evidence

- B L^T L B^T reproduces the certified current geometry for every additive frame normalization.
- Equal metrics with differently oriented or differently identified legs remain distinct as measurement coordinates.
- Leg reversal, direct sum, support, basis, units, and signature laws pass.
- No constructor silently creates all searchlight pairs.
- Fixed learned legs require frozen training provenance; fitting remains outside the core.
- Existing frame calls retain their current behavior.

Ownership boundary

Own measurement values, additive adapters, and their validation tests. Numerical contraction and durable results belong to later epics.

Deferred non-goals

No local training, hyperalignment, automatic latent basis selection, pseudoinverse reconstruction, or public connectivity API.
set.title: Epic 3: Add identified measurement legs, frames, edges, and decompositions
